metadata.title: SSPP - COBO L2 Enhanced-Assurance Managed Endpoint
metadata.remarks: Normative System Security Plan Profile defining enhanced assurance requirements for COBO L2 institution-owned, centrally managed endpoints. COBO L2 builds on COBO L1 by introducing additional security controls required for participation in higher-risk institutional workflows.

import-profile.remarks: COBO L2 explicitly inherits all requirements defined in the COBO L1 Managed Endpoint SSPP.

system-characteristics.system-description: Institution-owned, centrally managed endpoint providing enhanced assurance beyond the COBO L1 baseline. COBO L2 endpoints are intended for users with elevated institutional responsibilities or access to higher-risk workflows, while remaining general-purpose in nature.

props.name: assurance-model
props.remarks: Provides assurance beyond baseline through additional controls and stricter enforcement.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Endpoint remains institution-owned; personal ownership is not permitted.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Endpoint remains centrally enrolled and governed.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Endpoint may participate in workflows involving Data Classification Levels 1–3, subject to policy, role, and contextual controls.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: COBO L2 assurance does not confer automatic entitlement to any data classification.

system-implementation.remarks: COBO L2 endpoints inherit all Secure Endpoint requirements via COBO L1. This SSPP defines only the additional controls and enforcement expectations required to achieve enhanced assurance.

components.title: Enhanced Authentication and Session Assurance
components.description: Additional authentication and session protections beyond COBO L1 baseline.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Stricter enforcement of multi-factor authentication and session reauthentication where applicable.

components.title: Enhanced Configuration and Hardening
components.description: Stricter configuration baselines and reduced flexibility relative to COBO L1.

implemented-requirements.remarks: More restrictive default application execution and reduced support for user-installed software.

components.title: Enhanced Health and Compliance Enforcement
components.description: Tighter health enforcement and faster remediation expectations.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Stricter and more frequent posture assessment with lower tolerance for drift.

components.title: Enhanced Threat Detection and Containment
components.description: More aggressive response actions and lower tolerance for active threats.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Faster isolation and mandatory investigation for detected endpoint threats.

roles.title: Endpoint Service Owner
roles.remarks: Approves endpoint classification at the COBO L2 tier.

roles.title: Risk and Security Approval Authority
roles.remarks: Validates business justification for COBO L2 assignment.

control-implementation.remarks: COBO L2 satisfies all COBO L1 controls and introduces additional assurance controls required for higher-risk workflows. No compensating controls or risk acceptances are defined at this tier.
